story: Twenty Years of Open Source Erlang: A Retrospective from the trenches
text: I had never watched Erlang the Movie before, this is truly a gem: [VIDEO] This is a great way to explain the benefits of Erlang. Anyone who has tried to write robust, distributed systems should immediately see the benefits. Even all of these years later.

story: Let's Encrypt OCSP and Issuance Outage Postmortem
text: Their original video demo of hot code swapping is also a classic worth checking out: [VIDEO] That got a lot of programmers interested in Erlang ~10yrs ago.

story: Show HN: Siproc – A primitive SIP client that spawns processes for each call
text: Spawning a process for each call / endpoint is how almost every large phone switchboard does it. See also: Erlang The Movie: [VIDEO]

story: A Brief Guide to OTP in Elixir
text: This is the original video in its 90s glory: [VIDEO] Regardless of where the call is handled, you can't just deploy a new switch in a telecom network, but you still want to upgrade them. This is where you really want hot code loading.
